Anu: quick heads-up: qbench onboarding for q4b-int8-2026 showed ~6% drop on long-context summarization tasks vs q4b-int4 baseline. Holding relabels until we triage. :eyes:
Mike R: Can you paste the failing prompt ids? I can run targeted quant kernels.
Anu: sample ids: s-12902 s-12907 s-13055. Metrics: ROUGE-L down from 0.62 -> 0.58 on avg. Logs: https://internal/runs/5098765432 (artifacts in s3).
label-bot: qbench-run finished: 5098765432-embed-stability. Artifacts: s3://redwood/qbench/5098765432/results.json
Sara L: We were about to refresh golden set; we can freeze the golden pool for these cohorts. How many affected samples?
Anu: ~320 in the longctx cohort, 18 in golden. Let's mark golden for manual recheck. Also flagged some de-dupe noise — duplicate paraphrases slipped into seedbank.
Juniper: I'll spin up a kernel-compare job across kernels (fused-attn v1 / v2). Suggest running:
```
./tools/qrun compare --model q4b-int8-2026 --kernels fused-v1,fused-v2 --ids s-12902,s-13055 --out /tmp/comp.json
```
Mike R: Running now. Also trying fallback quant profiles (per-layer clip). Will post diffs.
Anu: If kernel-compare rules out runtime, next step is re-eval with prefix-KV caching disabled to check KV-cache sensitivity. I can open a quick canary to re-label 50 samples.
Sara L: Ok - hold large relabel batches. We'll bump priority for the 18 gold items and allocate 3 reviewers.
label-bot: :thumbsup: golden items bumped to high-priority queue 423
Mike R: Got first diff: fused-v2 reduces divergence on s-12902 by 0.8 BLEU points. Uploading diff: https://ci/compare/5098765432
Anu: Nice. Can we try quant-profile 'per-layer-clip-0.02' on a 50-sample canary next hour? If stable, update onboard playbook and note rollback criteria.
Juniper: Scheduled kernel-compare and canary; infra note: this will consume ~2 GPU-hours on dedicated pool.
Sara L: I'll prepare a short promptset for the 50-sample canary and put labelers on standby.
Mike R: Posting quick snippet to re-run eval locally:
```
python eval/run_eval.py --model q4b-int8-2026 --ids-file canary_ids.txt --quant-profile per-layer-clip-0.02
```
Anu: Thanks — will coordinate post-canary call in #eng-ml tomorrow 10am PT. If canary fails, revert to int4 and pause onboarding.
